title: Colorability and realizability defects in resource-dominated packing relaxations
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the main results of the author's preprint "Colorability and Realizability Defects in Resource-Dominated Packing Relaxations" (Erdős #81 series, Paper V). For a conflict system (finite objects with a symmetric irreflexive conflict relation) and a multiset X of objects, the loss between fractional and integral packings is bounded by the colourability defect D_q of the conflict graph H[X] of the copies (Lemma 3.1, Corollary 3.2, Theorems 3.3, 3.4, 3.4w), and, more generally, by the cost of a realizability certificate whose classes are realized in a fixed target system (Theorems 4.2 and 4.4). Applications: host completion through list edge colouring of bipartite multigraphs (Theorem 5.2: Galvin and Borodin–Kostochka–Woodall; Corollary 5.3; Example 5.5, a quadratic separation on K_{r,r}), the vertex-copy inequalities ν₃*(G_{v→u}) + ν₃*(G_{u→v}) ≤ 2ν₃*(G), ν₃(G_{v→u}) + ν₃(G_{u→v}) ≤ 2ν₃(G) + oct(H[T₂]) and ≤ 3ν₃(G) for triangle packings (Theorems 6.1, 6.2, Corollary 6.2a) and mixed triangle/K₄ copy inequalities (Theorem 7.3). Eighteen statements in all.
